card.name: Linking words before treatment duration
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (for, every, of, a closing parenthesis, a comma) in dosing instructions, right before a duration, schedule or treatment-setting phrase. Mostly in cancer-drug dosing text.

modes.label: Duration or schedule link
modes.description: The word 'for' or 'every' just before a length of treatment or interval.

modes.label: Link before indication
modes.description: A word like 'for' or 'of' right before the disease or use being treated.
modes.example: in Combination with Tremelimumab-actl and Platinum-Based Chemotherapy The recommended dosage schedule and regimens for IMFINZI for the treatment<< of>> metastatic NSCLC are provided in

modes.label: Punctuation after dose details
modes.description: A comma, bracket or the word food closing the dose clause before 'until' or a timing phrase.
